question.en: Why is 'Crop Rotation' considered an effective agronomic practice for sustainable soil management?
question.hi: Why is 'Crop Rotation' considered an effective agronomic practice for sustainable soil management?

text.en: It completely eliminates the need for chemical fertilizers
text.hi: It completely eliminates the need for chemical fertilizers

text.en: It breaks pest and disease cycles and improves soil fertility through nitrogen fixation
text.hi: It breaks pest and disease cycles and improves soil fertility through nitrogen fixation

text.en: It standardizes market prices for food grains
text.hi: It standardizes market prices for food grains

text.en: It reduces the requirement of irrigation water to zero
text.hi: It reduces the requirement of irrigation water to zero

explanation.en: Crop rotation breaks pest/disease cycles and includes legumes that fix atmospheric nitrogen, thereby restoring soil health and reducing reliance on synthetic inputs.
explanation.hi: Crop rotation breaks pest/disease cycles and includes legumes that fix atmospheric nitrogen, thereby restoring soil health and reducing reliance on synthetic inputs.
